rule: Every entry traces to a source document, the founder approval, an implementation change and a validation result. Founder approval of a direction does not answer questions the source leaves open.

seasonDecisions.subject: S-1 / NR-1 Hybrid H
seasonDecisions.decision: Sloane stops deciding for everyone else and keeps her love of facilitating. She does not retire or abandon The Exchange. Her arc: being needed is not the same as being loved. S1-75 Living Legacy mechanics unchanged.

seasonDecisions.subject: S-2 / NR-2 Option A
seasonDecisions.decision: 86 releases, IDs S1-01..S1-86 in established order, runtime target 127:40: the authoritative development master.

seasonDecisions.subject: S-2 / NR-2 Option B
seasonDecisions.decision: 81-release lean map kept as a pre-cleared production fallback only. No merge is active; each needs separate founder activation after production testing.

seasonDecisions.subject: BASELINE V1
seasonDecisions.decision: The original 86-release map is immutable historical evidence.

seasonDecisions.subject: S-3 / NR-4 N1 + N2
seasonDecisions.decision: Nights integrated into existing releases: S1-20 Nineteen Eighty-Six, S1-40 The Breakfast Dance. No release added. Longest run without a Night: 19.

recommendations.subject: NR-3 Ten patron scenarios
recommendations.decision: All ten retained. Revisions adopted: PX-04 discreet family (S1-62, S1-64, S1-72), PX-05 Nineteen Eighty-Six (S1-12, S1-20), PX-07 The Breakfast Dance (S1-37, S1-40), PX-08 hat stories (S1-51), PX-01 sponsorship line (S1-45). Original payoffs kept.

recommendations.subject: NR-5 Disclosure setting
recommendations.decision: Richard's disclosure happens at a Night Sloane hosted (S1-20). The chain is unchanged: Royce's inference + Richard → Bunny → Marcus.
recommendations.notes: The founder named all four links; causal mechanics may not change without source-supported authorization.

recommendations.subject: NR-6 Motive emphasis
recommendations.decision: FD-02 leads with the loved-or-useful question. The weight of her word and her mother's withdrawal stay as compatible elements.

recommendations.subject: NR-7 Plan C
recommendations.decision: The 74-release architecture with Plans A, B and C (FD-17) is superseded as the active structure and archived.

recommendations.subject: NR-8 Two fashion beats
recommendations.decision: S1-43: a Duel look worn as armour. S1-81: Tina in Ophelia's coat (S1-81 chosen over S1-82 on continuity evidence). No release added.
recommendations.notes: Direction approved; exact placement and wording are this sprint's implementation and await founder confirmation. Designs wait on U-4.

recommendations.subject: NR-9 Tina as friend
recommendations.decision: Shown in S1-81 through one request-free message, not exposition.

recommendations.subject: NR-10 C-11 Category Is
recommendations.decision: Held for Season 2. Not placed in Season 1.

recommendations.subject: NR-11 Reusable library
recommendations.decision: Reusable set, wardrobe and prop library is a prerequisite for scaled screenplay production.

characterDecisions.subject: Principal ages
characterDecisions.decision: Sloane 33, Gideon 44, Nadine 40, Richard 66, Kai 34. Vivienne died ten years ago at 55.

characterDecisions.subject: Sloane
characterDecisions.decision: Resumed leadership at 28. Loves impossible requests. Season 1 is about agency, intimacy, receiving care and no longer deciding for everyone; not retirement or defeat.

characterDecisions.subject: Gideon Shaw
characterDecisions.decision: Platonic with Sloane. Independent life and future; the overseas choice (S1-85) is his own. Facial identity lock unchanged.

characterDecisions.subject: Nadine
characterDecisions.decision: Arc: included rather than told last. Hospital COO, sabbatical trajectory and family dynamics preserved as written in the master.
characterDecisions.notes: Partner and children's names in the hybrid remain provisional.

characterDecisions.subject: Richard
characterDecisions.decision: Loving father with human flaws; the disclosure never makes him a villain.

characterDecisions.subject: Vivienne
characterDecisions.decision: Ember and final-exchange mysteries preserved, with writers'-room truth kept distinct from audience knowledge. Her private truth stays open (U-1).

characterDecisions.subject: Kai Fontaine
characterDecisions.decision: Excluded former collaborator; plot function, history with Sloane and emotional accountability preserved.

characterDecisions.subject: Kai appearance and voice
characterDecisions.decision: Light-skinned Black man, about 5'10", hazel-green eyes, braided-back locs with clean barbered edges and lineup, polished grooming, refined formal-casual tailoring, waistcoats, quiet-luxury jewelry, light facial hair. Intelligent, articulate, charming, dryly sarcastic, fluent in Black queer creative culture, capable of direct sincerity. Never reduced to slang, comic relief or stereotype.
characterDecisions.notes: No facial identity asset exists. His sexuality is not inferred or fixed from styling or speech.
